quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。

quote: If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.
claim: 原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多的隐藏单元来精确建模，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其是当标注训练数据有限时 [p2]。

quote: If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.
claim: 这些权重向量在留出测试数据上会做出不同预测，且几乎都会比在训练数据上表现更差，因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作而非在测试数据上 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出用“dropout”来防止训练数据上的复杂共适应：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以0.5的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: dropout也可以被看作一种非常高效的神经网络模型平均方式，它使得在合理时间内训练大量不同网络成为可能，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。

quote: Dropout can be seen as an extreme form of bagging in which each model is trained on a single case and each parameter of the model is very strongly regularized by sharing it with the corresponding parameter in all the other models.
claim: 作者还将dropout视为bagging的极端形式，其中每个模型在单个样本上训练，且每个参数通过与其他所有模型中的对应参数共享而受到非常强的正则化 [p16]。

quote: The MNIST dataset consists of 28 $\times$ 28 digit images - 60,000 for training and 10,000 for testing.
claim: 论文在MNIST数据集上进行了实验，该数据集包含28×28的数字图像，其中60,000张用于训练、10,000张用于测试，目标是将数字图像分类到正确的数字类别 [A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: The MNIST dataset consists of 28 $\times$ 28 digit images - 60,000 for training and 10,000 for testing.
claim: 作者测试了不同架构的神经网络（不同隐藏单元数和层数），包括784-800-800-10、784-1200-1200-10、784-2000-2000-10和784-1200-1200-1200-10四种网络，对所有隐藏单元使用50%的dropout率、对可见单元使用20%的dropout率 [A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: The MNIST dataset consists of 28 $\times$ 28 digit images - 60,000 for training and 10,000 for testing.
claim: 训练使用随机梯度下降，minibatch大小为100，目标函数为交叉熵，学习率从10.0开始每轮乘以0.998，训练进行3000轮 [A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: We show two nets - one with a 2000-2000-1000-50 and another with a 2000-1000-1000-50 architecture trained with and without dropout.
claim: 此外，论文还在Reuters数据集上进行了实验，展示了2000-2000-1000-50和2000-1000-1000-50两种架构在有和无dropout下的训练和测试集误差 [A3.p4]。

quote: Our models for CIFAR-10 and ImageNet are deep, feed-forward convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
claim: 论文还针对CIFAR-10和ImageNet使用了深度前馈卷积神经网络（CNN）模型 [A6.p1]。

quote: Random “dropout” gives big improvements on many benchmark tasks and sets new records for speech and object recognition.
claim: 随机dropout在许多基准任务上带来大幅改进，并在语音和物体识别上创下新纪录 [p1]。

quote: As in all previous datasets discussed so far, we obtain significant improvements here too.
claim: 在Reuters数据集上，与之前讨论的所有数据集一样，dropout也带来了显著改进，学习不仅带来更好的泛化，而且进展平滑，无需早停 [A3.p4]。

quote: The features that dropout learns are simpler and look like strokes, whereas the ones learned by standard backpropagation are difficult to interpret.
claim: 通过查看784-500-500神经网络学习的第一层特征，发现dropout学到的特征更简单、看起来像笔画，而标准反向传播学到的特征难以解释，这证实dropout确实迫使判别模型学习更少共适应的好特征，从而带来更好的泛化 [A1.SS3.p1]。

quote: This is clearly demonstrated by the fact that using non-convolutional higher layers with a lot of parameters leads to a big improvement with dropout but makes things worse without dropout.
claim: 在ImageNet上，使用非卷积的高层且参数很多时，dropout带来大幅改进，而不用dropout则使情况变糟 [A8.p3]。

quote: This reduces the net’s representational capacity, but it also reduces its capacity to overfit, so dropout is far less advantageous in convolutional layers.
claim: 原文指出，卷积共享滤波器架构的一个后果是相对于所有神经元使用不同滤波器的神经网络大幅减少了参数数量，这降低了网络的表示能力，但也降低了过拟合的能力，因此dropout在卷积层中远没有那么有优势 [A6.p3]。

quote: Our extremely deep residual nets are easy to optimize, but the counterpart “plain” nets (that simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the depth increases
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练难度增加，且存在退化问题——普通网络深度增加时训练误差反而更高 [S1.p7]。

quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance, and the leading results on the challenging ImageNet dataset all exploit “very deep” models, with a depth of sixteen to thirty.
claim: 其动机在于网络深度对图像分类至关重要，领先的 ImageNet 结果都使用了十六到三十层的极深模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
claim: 作者提出疑问：学习更好的网络是否像堆叠更多层一样简单 [S1.p2]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，显式地让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，将原始映射重铸为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参照映射更容易 [S1.p5]。

quote: We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation, following.
claim: 在 ImageNet 实现中，采用批归一化、SGD（mini-batch 256，学习率从 0.1 开始，误差平台时除以 10，训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代，权重衰减 0.0001，动量 0.9），不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: Next we evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer residual nets ( ResNets).
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 分类数据集上评估了 18 层和 34 层残差网络，并与对应的普通网络比较 [S4.SS1.p5]。

quote:
[S4.SS2.p1] We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
[S4.SS2.p2] The network inputs are 32 $\times$ 32 images, with the per-pixel mean subtracted.
[S4.SS2.p2] There are totally 6 $n$ +2 stacked weighted layers.
[S4.SS2.p2] The numbers of filters are $\{16,32,64\}$ respectively.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 数据集（50k 训练图像、10k 测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，使用简单架构，输入为 32×32 图像，网络为 6n+2 层堆叠加权层，滤波器数为 {16,32,64} [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 目标检测任务上，采用 Faster R-CNN，将 VGG-16 替换为 ResNet-101 进行验证 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 更好（提升 2.8%），且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error
claim: 与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型在验证集上取得 4.49% 的 top-5 误差，优于所有先前集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的 top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难，随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement.
claim: 在 COCO 目标检测上，ResNet-101 相比 VGG-16 在 mAP@[.5,.95] 上提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，在 CIFAR-10 上 1202 层网络的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相似，作者认为这是因为过拟合，1202 层网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大（19.4M） [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，作者表示结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.
claim: 主流序列转换模型基于复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，包含编码器和解码器，性能最好的模型还通过注意力机制连接编码器与解码器 [abstract]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 注意力机制已成为各类序列建模与转换模型的重要组成部分，能建模输入或输出序列中不受距离限制的依赖关系，但除少数情况外，这类注意力机制都与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
claim: 本文旨在提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.
claim: 作者提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制建立输入与输出的全局依赖，摒弃循环与卷积 [S1.p4]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其核心是缩放点积注意力：输入由维度为 d_k 的查询和键、维度为 d_v 的值组成，计算查询与所有键的点积，各自除以 √d_k，再经 softmax 得到值上的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections to $d_{k}$, $d_{k}$ and $d_{v}$ dimensions, respectively.
claim: 模型还使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值用不同的学习到的线性投影投影 h 次，并行执行注意力后拼接并再次投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: The Transformer uses multi-head attention in three different ways
claim: Transformer 以三种方式使用多头注意力：编码器-解码器注意力、编码器自注意力，以及带掩码以保持自回归性质的解码器自注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
claim: 论文在两个机器翻译任务上进行实验，即 WMT 2014 英德和英法翻译任务 [abstract]。

quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
claim: 英德任务上模型达到 28.4 BLEU，英法任务上以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU [abstract]。

quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
claim: 作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，在大量和有限训练数据两种设置下均成功 [abstract]。

quote: We used a beam size of $21$ and $\alpha=0.3$ for both WSJ only and the semi-supervised setting.
claim: 在成分句法分析实验中，作者仅在 Section 22 开发集上做了少量实验来选择 dropout、学习率和 beam 大小，其余参数保持与英德基础翻译模型一致，推理时将最大输出长度增至输入长度加 300，beam 大小为 21、α=0.3 [S6.SS3.p3]。

quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，模型达到 28.4 BLEU，超过包括集成模型在内的现有最佳结果 2 BLEU 以上 [abstract]。

quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
claim: 在英法任务上，模型以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天建立了 41.8 的单模型 BLEU 新纪录，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分 [abstract]。

quote: a self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations, whereas a recurrent layer requires $O(n)$ sequential operations.
claim: 自注意力层以常数数量的顺序执行操作连接所有位置，而循环层需要 O(n) 顺序操作；当序列长度 n 小于表示维度 d 时，自注意力层比循环层更快 [S4.p4]。

quote: As side benefit, self-attention could yield more interpretable models.
claim: 作为附带好处，自注意力可能产生更可解释的模型，单个注意力头明显学会执行不同任务，许多头表现出与句子句法和语义结构相关的行为 [S4.p6]。

quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的输入序列邻域，这会把最大路径长度增至 O(n/r)，作者表示计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限的注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但其访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务特定架构，且提供决策来源和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 已有结合掩码语言模型与可微检索器的混合模型（REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答 [S1.p1]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 本文旨在将参数与非参数记忆的混合引入序列到序列模型这一“NLP 的主力” [S1.p1]。

quote: We build RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq transformer, and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.
claim: RAG 通过通用微调方法为预训练参数记忆生成模型赋予非参数记忆：参数记忆是预训练 seq2seq transformer（BART），非参数记忆是 Wikipedia 的稠密向量索引，由预训练神经检索器（DPR）访问 [S1.p2]。

quote: We build RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq transformer, and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.
claim: 检索器根据输入提供潜在文档，seq2seq 模型结合这些潜在文档与输入生成输出，并以 top-K 近似对潜在文档进行边缘化，可基于每个输出（假设同一文档负责所有 token）或基于每个 token（不同文档负责不同 token）[S1.p2]。

quote: We build RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq transformer, and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.
claim: RAG 可在任意 seq2seq 任务上微调，生成器与检索器联合学习 [S1.p2]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 实验使用单一 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，采用 2018 年 12 月版本，每篇文章切分为不重叠的 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，并用 FAISS 构建单一 MIPS 索引（Hierarchical Navigable Small World 近似）以快速检索 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时对每个查询检索 top k 文档，k∈{5,10}，测试时的 k 由开发数据设定 [S3.p1]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 在抽象式问答上，使用 MSMARCO NLG v2.1，仅使用问题与答案，不使用提供的段落，将其视为开放域抽象式问答任务 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: Our RAG models achieve state-of-the-art results on open Natural Questions, WebQuestions and CuratedTrec and strongly outperform recent approaches that use specialised pre-training objectives on TriviaQA.
claim: RAG 模型在开放域 Natural Questions、WebQuestions 和 CuratedTrec 上取得当时最优结果，并在 TriviaQA 上大幅优于使用专门预训练目标的近期方法 [S1.p4]。

quote: Our RAG models achieve state-of-the-art results on open Natural Questions, WebQuestions and CuratedTrec and strongly outperform recent approaches that use specialised pre-training objectives on TriviaQA.
claim: 尽管这些是抽取式任务，无约束生成仍优于先前的抽取式方法 [S1.p4]。

quote: Our RAG models achieve state-of-the-art results on open Natural Questions, WebQuestions and CuratedTrec and strongly outperform recent approaches that use specialised pre-training objectives on TriviaQA.
claim: 在知识密集型生成任务（MS-MARCO 和 Jeopardy 问题生成）上，模型生成的回答比 BART 基线更符合事实、更具体且更多样 [S1.p4]。

quote: Our RAG models achieve state-of-the-art results on open Natural Questions, WebQuestions and CuratedTrec and strongly outperform recent approaches that use specialised pre-training objectives on TriviaQA.
claim: 在 FEVER 事实核查上，结果与使用强检索监督的流水线模型相差 4.3% 以内 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S1.p4] Our RAG models achieve state-of-the-art results on open Natural Questions, WebQuestions and CuratedTrec and strongly outperform recent approaches that use specialised pre-training objectives on TriviaQA.
[S1.p4] Despite these being extractive tasks, we find that unconstrained generation outperforms previous extractive approaches.
[S1.p4] For knowledge-intensive generation, we experiment with MS-MARCO and Jeopardy question generation, and we find that our models generate responses that are more factual, specific, and diverse than a BART baseline.
[S1.p4] For FEVER fact verification, we achieve results within 4.3% of state-of-the-art pipeline models which use strong retrieval supervision.
[S1.p4] Finally, we demonstrate that the non-parametric memory can be replaced to update the models’ knowledge as the world changes.
[S6.p1] we illustrated how the retrieval index can be hot-swapped to update the model without requiring any retraining.
claim: 非参数记忆可被替换以更新模型知识，无需重新训练 [S1.p4][S6.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 在初步实验中，作者观察到对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”，学会无论输入如何都检索相同文档；一旦检索崩溃，生成器会学会忽略文档，RAG 模型的表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者推测崩溃可能由于某些任务对事实知识的需求不够明确，或目标序列较长导致检索器梯度信息较少 [A8.p1]。

quote: In future work, it may be fruitful to investigate if the two components can be jointly pre-trained from scratch, either with a denoising objective similar to BART or some another objective.
claim: 未来工作可研究两个组件能否从头联合预训练 [S6.p1]。

quote:

quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
claim: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）的抽象来连接结构化SSM与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote:
[S3.SS3.p3] the sequence transformation operator $\mathsf{SSM}$ ( Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator $\mathsf{SSS}$ ( Definition 3.2)

claim: 核心思想是证明状态空间模型等价于一类称为半可分矩阵的结构化矩阵，从而将SSM的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p3][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote:

quote: We performed an extensive series of evaluations of Llama 3, investigating the performance of: (1) the pre-trained language model, (2) the post-trained language model, and (3) the safety characteristics of Llama 3.

claim: 预训练评估覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估等八类标准基准 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Table 16: Post-training benchmarks by category. Overview of all benchmarks we use to evaluate post-trained Llama 3 models, ordered by capability.

quote: These errors, whose origins are not yet understood, set a current error floor of $10^{-10}$.
claim: 重复码实验表明，逻辑性能受约每小时发生一次的罕见关联错误事件限制，当前错误下限约为 10⁻¹⁰ [S1.p3]。

[S3.SS1.p1] The experimental section evaluates the performance of Qwen2.5-VL across a variety of datasets, comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
[S3.SS2.p1] we selected several representative benchmarks to assess the model’s capabilities across a variety of domains, including general tasks, mathematics and science tasks, coding tasks, and alignment task.
[S3.SS3.SSS1.p3] in high-resolution real-world scenarios, specifically on the MME-RealWorld benchmark, Qwen2.5-VL demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with a score of 63.2
[S3.SS3.SSS2.p3] on composite OCR-related understanding benchmarks as OCRBench, InfoVQA which focusing on infographics, and SEED-Bench-2-Plus covering text-rich scenarios including charts, maps, and webs
[S3.SS3.SSS3.p3] Qwen2.5-VL achieves leading performance across different benchmarks from box-grounding, and point-grounding to counting.
[S3.SS3.SSS5.p2] The performance of Qwen2.5-VL-72B demonstrates exceptional advancements across GUI grounding benchmarks.
claim: 评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学任务、纯文本任务、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解以及 GUI Agent 等基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 在大学水平问题上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上得分 70.2，在 MMMU-Pro 上得分 51.1，超越此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在数学任务上，MathVista 得分 74.8，超过此前开源最优的 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL achieves a good performance of 43.1 mAP on ODinW-13
claim: 在空间理解上，ODinW-13 上达到 43.1 mAP，CountBench 上以“先检测后计数”提示达到 93.6 的准确率 [S3.SS3.SSS3.p3]。

quote: It achieves 87.1% accuracy on ScreenSpot, competing strongly with Gemini 2.0 (84.0%) and Claude (83.0%)
claim: 在 GUI 基准上，ScreenSpot 达到 87.1% 准确率，ScreenSpot Pro 达到 43.6%，远超 Aguvis-72B（23.6%）和 Qwen2-VL-72B（1.6%）[S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: on the MMStar dataset, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 63.9%, while Qwen2.5-VL-3B scores 55.9%.
claim: 较小的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 3B 也表现有竞争力，例如 MMStar 上分别为 63.9% 和 55.9% [S3.SS3.SSS1.p4]。
